# `serve` commands

## `serve`

Serve every routed command over HTTP and the loopback socket, holding the data-root lock until interrupted.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | hub |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | human hub administrator |
| Capability | serve |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | Local only; no HTTP route. |

### CLI

`bookflow serve --bind 127.0.0.1:8765 --json`

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bind` | `--bind` | string | no | no | "127.0.0.1:8765" | Address to listen on, host:port; maximum length 128 |
| `allow_network` | `--allow-network` | boolean | no | no | false | Allow a bind address outside loopback |
| `secure_cookies` | `--secure-cookies` | boolean \| null | no | yes | null | Set Secure on the session cookie; defaults on for non-loopback binds |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object on stdout after orderly shutdown; the readiness line is written to stderr. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |

### HTTP

This command has no HTTP route.

### Output

| JSON field | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bind` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `socket` | string \| null | yes | yes | — | — |
| `pid` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `secure_cookies` | boolean | yes | no | — | — |
| `companies_migrated` | array[string] | yes | no | — | — |
| `companies_failed` | array[object[string, string]] | yes | no | — | — |
| `warnings` | array[string] | no | no | [] | — |

Example JSON output:

```json
{
  "bind": "value",
  "companies_failed": [],
  "companies_migrated": [],
  "pid": 1,
  "secure_cookies": false,
  "socket": null,
  "warnings": []
}
```

### Errors

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `E_COMPANY_AMBIGUOUS` | More than one company matches; use the id or Organization/Company. |
| `E_COMPANY_MISSING` | The company's registered folder does not exist. |
| `E_COMPANY_NOT_FOUND` | No such company. |
| `E_CONFIG_INVALID` | The configuration file could not be read. |
| `E_CONTEXT_IN_INPUT` | Input contains a context field. |
| `E_DB_BUSY` | Another Bookflow command is running on this data root. |
| `E_FEATURE_DISABLED` | This feature is not enabled for the company. |
| `E_FS_UNKNOWN` | The filesystem type of the path could not be determined. |
| `E_INTERNAL` | Internal failure. |
| `E_IO` | A filesystem operation failed. |
| `E_MIGRATION_FAILED` | A schema migration failed; the database was backed up first and is unchanged. |
| `E_NETWORK_NOT_ALLOWED` | Binding outside loopback needs --allow-network. |
| `E_NETWORK_SHARE` | The path is on a network filesystem, which Bookflow refuses to use. |
| `E_NOT_INITIALIZED` | The data root is not initialized; run `bookflow init`. |
| `E_NO_ACTOR` | This login is not mapped to a Bookflow user. |
| `E_ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND` | No such organization. |
| `E_PERMISSION` | The acting user may not run this command here. |
| `E_REASON_REQUIRED` | Writes by an agent need --reason or --directive. |
| `E_SCHEMA_BEHIND` | The database schema is behind this version of Bookflow; run `bookflow upgrade`. |
| `E_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN` | The database schema revision is not known to this version of Bookflow; upgrade Bookflow. |
| `E_UNAUTHENTICATED` | No valid credential: log in, or send a bearer token. |
| `E_USAGE` | Invalid command syntax. |
| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |
| `E_VERSION_MISMATCH` | The running host and this client are different Bookflow versions; stop the host or upgrade the client. |

`serve` is long-running. Its readiness line is written to stderr and its JSON output to stdout during orderly shutdown. It holds the data-root lock until interrupted, but compatible CLI and Python calls on the same machine are handed to the running host through its local socket; they do not compete for the lock. A second host or an incompatible local client can receive `E_DB_BUSY`.
